notes.title: December 2022 patch
notes.notes:
Some cards have been updated:
- Shifting Sands now works directly from the player's hand;
- Eternal Rose, Hidden Spring and Foresight now can be activated anytome during the initial phase
- Many texts have been modified.

notes.title: Game update 1.0.4.0
notes.notes:
New shop and gems feature
As promised a new system for buying/selling cards has been developed. Now after a victory every player gets cards as well as GEMS as a reward. These gems can be traded for cards in the game shop. You may also sell your collected cards in excange for gems in order to manage your collection more freely!

Other bugs solved
A serious bug that prevented card text boxes from being loaded has been solved.

notes.title: Big news, version 1.0.3.0
First update vers. 1.0.2.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.2.6
The first update has solved some serious game-breaking bugs. Also, the message box translation between two PvP players with different languages is not mixed up anymore.
Next things to improve:
- enhancing the AI for single-player
- giving prizes even in single-player games
- improving the "prize cards" system
